conviction_note: A new, unpre-released quarter on a thin ($163k/day), 70%-vol, retail-driven name, so the size is large (10%). The sign is close to a coin: the cost programme and a very soft Q3 2025 comparison (adjusted EBIT 4 MSEK, reported -34) make a strong YoY headline likely, but the stock has risen from 19 to 51 SEK since 30 June, well past the only published valuation (Analysguiden, 35 SEK). So p_up is 52 and the scaled number is +0.4. The findings sum to +0.7 because the mechanical-improvement finding is sized on its own and the valuation finding was shrunk for agreeing with the free control; the two measurements are not fitted to each other.

Savings programme of about 50 MSEK a year, full effect during 2026
Analysguiden (commissioned research) forecasts FY2026 EBIT of 80 MSEK, fair value 35 SEK

bar: Weak. The only published forecast is Analysguiden's commissioned FY2026 EBIT of 80 MSEK (implying about 41 MSEK for H2, no quarterly split) and fair value of 35 SEK, from 2026-09-01 (https://www.aktiespararna.se/analyser/elon-ab-positiva-tongangar-fran-forsta-kvartalet-aven-under-andra-kvartalet). Yahoo shows no consensus and the baseline has analyst_count null. At 51 SEK the price implies more than that analyst's numbers, so the real bar is unsourced and the quarter-level findings are capped.

The company's own Q2 report calendar gives 'Delårsrapport kvartal 3 18 november' (https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/af724980e32cac3838c7c4e751218c805). positioning_check: FI register (as_of 2026-11-17) names no disclosed net short at or above 0.5%; anchor_covered false, so this is a truncated zero and not evidence that nobody is short, and priced_lean_pct (-0.76) is essentially the run-up. The building/covering direction is unknown. Ownership: Elon Group Holding AB 54.7%, Håkan Lissinger 7.3%, Avanza Pension 2.7% at 30 June 2026, so the free float is under half and thin.

findings.finding: The cost programme and a very soft comparison make a strong YoY swing in Q3 likely. Q3 2025 EBIT was -34 MSEK reported and 4 MSEK adjusted (EPS -4.62). H1 2026 overhead was 59 MSEK lower than a year earlier (24 MSEK in Q2). The YoY EBIT gain was +32 MSEK in Q1 and +38 MSEK in Q2. Q3 EBIT of roughly 25-40 MSEK against -34 would be the headline, above the 41 MSEK H2 pace implied by the only analyst's FY80.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two turnaround prints were bought: 2026-05-12 Q1 +9.7% (EBIT 18.8 vs -13.4) and 2026-08-27 Q2 +27.9% (EBIT 19.8 vs -18.5), from Yahoo daily closes. The 2025 prints, all weak, fell 4.1%, 8.5%, 4.5% and 7.5%.
findings.original_quote: "Rörelseresultatet (EBIT) uppgick till -34 MSEK (4) ... Justerat för dessa jämförelsestörande poster uppgick rörelseresultatet i kvartalet till 4 MSEK (4)." (Q3 2025: EBIT was -34 MSEK; adjusted for items affecting comparability, 4 MSEK). Q2 2026: "koncernens omkostnader (exklusive avskrivningar) har minskat med 59 MSEK från -360 MSEK till -301 MSEK" (group overheads excl. depreciation fell 59 MSEK, from -360 to -301).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is up 164% in 60 days and turnaround investors know the comparison. But the only published forecast (FY EBIT 80) implies H2 of about 41 MSEK, while extrapolating the Q1/Q2 YoY gains gives Q3 alone near that. If the market had fully priced a ~35 MSEK quarter, a sell-side estimate near it would exist and the price would have stalled at the Q2 level; there is no estimate, and the price rose another 40% after September with no company news. With no consensus, a large headline swing on a retail-held float is a surprise for a crowd that reads headlines.
findings.independence: The insider register (https://marknadssok.fi.se/publiceringsklient/sv-SE/Search/Search?SearchFunctionType=Insyn&Utgivare=Elon+AB) shows only buys after Q2: the CEO 300 shares at 29.00 on 2026-08-31 and board member Mats Karlsson 5,000 shares at 32.10-32.70 on 2026-09-24. Small, but no sells.

findings.finding: At 51 SEK the share sits 46% above the only published valuation (Analysguiden fair value 35 SEK, 2026-09-01, set on FY26 EBIT of 80 MSEK). It has risen from 19.00 SEK on 30 June, and from 32 to 52 between 24 Sep and 8 Oct with no company release. A good quarter may already be in the price, which raises the risk of selling the news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print after a run of this size. After the +27.9% Q2 day the stock kept rising (36 SEK by 1 Sep), then fell back 11% to 32 by mid-September.
findings.original_quote: "Som en följd av de positiva utsikterna höjer vi vårt motiverade värde till 35 kronor per aktie från tidigare 20 kronor per aktie, vilket motsvarar ev/ebitda på 5 respektive p/e 13 på vår prognos för 2026p" (As a result of the positive outlook we raise our fair value to SEK 35 per share from SEK 20, equal to EV/EBITDA 5 and P/E 13 on our 2026 forecast). "Sannolikheten för att Elon landar på ett positivt rörelseresultat i nivå med våra nya prognoser på 80 miljoner kronor för 2026 ser vi som mycket goda." (We see a very good chance of Elon reaching operating profit in line with our new 80 MSEK forecast for 2026.)
findings.why_not_priced: This is the run-up seen through a valuation, so it largely agrees with the free control (-run_up) and the priced lean (-0.76); that is why it is sized small. It differs from the control only in naming a sourced level the price has passed. If the market were anchored to that forecast, the price would be near 35.
findings.independence: Price path from Yahoo (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/ELON.ST?range=6mo&interval=1d) and the 30 June price and market value in the Q2 report (19.00 SEK, 282.3 MSEK). No independent valuation found.

findings.finding: Electrolux's Q3 2026 report (23 Oct) said European consumer confidence deteriorated in the quarter, a mild headwind for Elon's Q3 B2C appliance sales. Elon's B2C grew 4.1% in Q2, and its improvement has been cost-driven rather than volume-driven.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history on sales-only surprises. Q2 2026 sales of +2.5% came with the +27.9% day, but the margin was the line.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a supplier read-across, so it is a proxy. Elon's price rose after 23 Oct (41.0 on 23 Oct to 51 now), so the market did not weigh it. Electrolux also reported higher European volumes for itself, which weakens the read.
findings.independence: None confirmed. A Swedish SCB retail figure for September 2026 (+5.5% YoY volume, hurbra.se) was snippet-only and points the other way.

findings.finding: The Q2 report says the store-portfolio review continues ('right number of stores in the right places'). Q3 could therefore carry restructuring items, as Q3 2025 did (38 MSEK), which would dent reported EBIT against a headline-reading crowd.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 had 38 MSEK of restructuring and impairments plus a savings-programme release on the same morning; the stock fell 4.5%.
findings.original_quote: "Elons interna utbildningsprogram skalas upp med ytterligare utbildningsspår och översynen av butiksportföljen fortsätter, med mål att säkerställa rätt antal butiker på rätt platser." (Elon's internal training programme is being scaled up and the review of the store portfolio continues, aiming at the right number of stores in the right places.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is not quantified anywhere and no release has flagged a charge. This is an inference from a company statement, so it is sized as a one-off and kept small.

findings.finding: After the Q2 report, insiders only bought: CEO Henrik Aronsson 300 shares at 29.00 SEK (2026-08-31) and board member Mats Karlsson 5,000 shares at 32.10-32.70 SEK (2026-09-24). There are no insider sales in the June-November register.
findings.original_quote: "Mats Karlsson | Styrelseledamot | Förvärv | ... | 2026-09-24 | 4 529 | Antal | 32,7021 | SEK" (board member, acquisition, 4,529 shares at 32.7021 SEK)
findings.why_not_priced: These are small sums, public and made below today's price, so it is mostly priced. A board member buying days before the run that preceded the quarter is a weak positive signal.

baseline_tension: Mixed. The mechanical improvement finding cuts against the negative run-up lean (-0.76), while the valuation finding agrees with it, so the net sits near zero and the edge is in the size of the move, not its sign.
language_note: Every primary document (Q2/Q3 reports, inside-information releases, calendar) is published in Swedish only; the Nasdaq feed carries no English version for Elon. The Q3 2025 adjusted EBIT of 4 MSEK and the 'översynen av butiksportföljen fortsätter' line came from the Swedish text.
The only analyst view (Analysguiden/Aktiespararna, FY26 EBIT 80 MSEK, fair value 35 SEK) exists only in Swedish; English searches found price pages and no explanation of the run.
The insider register (FI Insynsregistret) is Swedish-language and corrected an English search summary that had turned a CEO purchase into a sale.
lessons_applied: 'Positioning is the thing to beat, not to agree with': the valuation/run-up finding agrees with the free control and the run-up-driven priced lean, so it was cut from -1.5 to -1.0 (kept, per the core).
'A narrow proxy loses': the Electrolux read-across was cut from -0.3 to -0.2.
'Size the move on what is new; let reaction history move p_up': abs_move_pct stays at 10 (new, unpre-released quarter, thin float) and is not capped by the 4.96% cadence proxy; p_up stays at 52.
The session check opens with the verdict (bmo) and a URL, as the file asks.
